scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev -w frontend" "npm run dev -w backend" "npm start --prefix ../wanderloop-ai-service"
scripts.build: npm run build -w frontend && npm run build -w backend && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); ['dist', 'build', 'out'].forEach(d => fs.cpSync('frontend/dist', d, {recursive:true}));" && node frontend/fix-permissions.js
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w frontend && npm run lint -w backend
scripts.format: npm run format -w frontend && npm run format -w backend
